Specification & Architectural Detail: TalentMatch AI Candidate Screening & Ranking Engine (v2.4)
TalentMatch AI B.V. (Keizersgracht 421, 1016 EK Amsterdam, Netherlands)
150+ Enterprise HR departments and talent acquisition agencies operating within the EU

Ingesting job postings and jobseeker applications, extracting qualifications, scoring candidates on a 0–100 suitability index, ranking applicants, and recommending top candidates for recruiter interview shortlists.
Human Recruiters, Talent Acquisition Managers, HR Operations Personnel
Job Applicants / Natural persons applying for employment roles across EU deployer organizations
Unstructured CVs/Resumes (PDF, DOCX, TXT), Cover Letters, Job Descriptions, Candidate Self-reported Application Data
5,000,000 historical job application records (2018–2024) collected across multi-sector EU employers, containing applicant resumes, job roles, interview decisions, and 2-year hire outcome indicators.

Hybrid Architecture: (1) Transformer-based NLP model (fine-tuned RoBERTa) for entity extraction and skill vectorization; (2) Gradient Boosted Decision Tree (XGBoost) regression model for job-fit scoring.
Overall Candidate Fit Score (0–100), Quantile Rank position, Top Skill Matches/Gaps, Local SHAP Feature Importance Explanations.
Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) model; Recruiters review ranked lists on dashboard and trigger interview invitations.
Multi-tenant SaaS hosted on Cloud Infrastructure (AWS EU Central 1 - Frankfurt), API-integrated into ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
PostgreSQL audit database logging inputs, model versions, outputs, recruiter overrides, and API request timestamps.
Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, XGBoost, AWS CloudWatch, OpenAI API (used for job description summarization).
